newsitem.title: USA: Nomura unit to spinoff real-estate unit-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Nomura unit to spinoff real-estate unit-WSJ.

text.p: Nomura Holding America Inc said it will partially spin off its real-estate division led by Ethan Penner, the Wall Street Journal reported.

In Friday's electronic edition, the paper said Nomura Holding, whose parent is Nomura Securities Co, will inject about $500 million into the new company and keep a stake of about 60.0 to 70.0 percent.
The remaining stake will be held by a management group led by Penner and Michael Berman, chief executive of Nomura Holding.
Both men will leave Nomura to run the new company, the paper said, adding that Penner's personal stake will be about 10.0 percent.
A sale of the real-estate unit would diminish one of Nomura's best sources of profits but lessen its risk, the paper also said.

The real-estate group, formed by Penner in 1993, had about $400 million in revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, although accounted for more than 40.0 percent of Nomura Holding's risk-based capital.
